paragraphs: Rabbi Chanilai bar Chanilai: [Avodah Zarah 18b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.18b.15). Nechemyah son of Rav Chanilai: [Eruvin 43b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.43b.16).

notes.text: The checked passages attest Rav Chana bar Chanilai, Rabbi Chanilai bar Chanilai, Nechemyah son of Rav Chanilai, and Rabbi Tanchum bar Chanilai at the supplied Bavli locators. This is a collection of patronymic attestations, not proof of one shared father. The heading’s R’ preserves the abbreviated title without assigning every listed father the son’s independently attested title.

The linked Eruvin calls Nechemyah the son of Rav Chanilai. [Heilprin’s Nechemyah notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2660&lang=en) gives a longer heading but quotes the shorter name in Eruvin. [Heilprin’s Tanchum notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3576&lang=en) also records a variant attribution for the Avodah Zarah saying.
